newsitem.title: USA: April Brent climbs slightly in late U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: April Brent climbs slightly in late U.S. trading.

text.p: April Brent climbed slightly in moderate late U.S. trading on Thursday, with one full cargo changing hands, traders said.
A full boat of April Brent traded at $20.39 a barrel, up four cents from the IPE settlement.
Four partials totalling 690 lots moved at $20.35 a barrel, flat with the London close.
Fifty more lots traded at $20.33 a barrel, two cents under the London settlement.
March/April Brent ended around plus 32-34 cents. No deals were transacted, although the intermonth spread attracted brisk activity over the day, with deals ranging from 28 to 33 cents.
The March Brent IPE contract expired today at $20.49 a barrel.
